title: bug: moe-agent.sh subagent mirror races when two seats start in one project (cp EEXIST under set -e kills pre-flight)
description: Repro (WT-19b trial, scripts/tests/worktree-e2e.cjs, two worker seats launched at once into a fresh control checkout): seat b exits 1 in pre-flight with `cp: cannot create regular file '<project>/.claude/agents/moe-code-reviewer.md': File exists`. Cause: scripts/moe-agent.sh:2130-2134 checks `[ -e "$dest" ]` and then runs a plain `cp "$src" "$dest"` under `set -e`; GNU cp opens a missing destination with O_EXCL, so the seat that loses the race dies (ps1 uses `Copy-Item -Force` and keeps going). Fix: tolerate EEXIST (`cp "$src" "$dest" 2>/dev/null || [ -e "$dest" ] || <fail>`) and count it as kept. Until then, WT-19b's fixture pre-seeds <control>/.claude/agents, which is the live checkout's state.
definitionOfDone: Two moe-agent.sh seats starting at the same moment in one project both pass the subagent mirror (a postflight.sh arm, or a loop of concurrent mirrors, reproduces it before the fix and passes after)
A destination that another seat created between the -e check and the copy counts as kept, not as a failure
